headlines.title: Trump says he ‘would not mind’ if Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO
headlines.description: President Donald Trump said he “wouldn’t mind” Jensen Huang being reinstated as CEO of Nvidia after he resigned.

headlines.title: Supreme Court rejects challenge to Maryland’s ‘sensitive places’ gun ban
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — The Supreme Court on Monday declined to hear a broad challenge to Maryland’s restrictions on people carrying firearms in a broad range of public areas.

headlines.title: Trump 'would not mind' having Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO
headlines.description: President Trump told reporters he "would not mind" if Jensen Huang were to be reinstated as Nvidia's CEO, saying he has "learned a big lesson" amid the scandal.

headlines.title: Trump blames FAA's nationwide ground stop on 'old equipment'
headlines.description: President Trump blamed the Federal Aviation Administration's nationwide ground stop on "old equipment" and stood by Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy's response to the incident.

headlines.title: Trump Set to Meet With Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin in Asia
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is set to depart for a three-day visit to Asia, with the trip culminating in an unprecedented meeting in China Thursday with President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: How the White House Correspondents’ Association dinner chaos unfolded
headlines.description: Secret Service faced challenges evacuating President, Vice President, Cabinet officials and Congressional leaders after gunman rushes D.C. gala.

headlines.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump over academic funding cuts related to DEI
headlines.description: The Supreme Court rejected President Donald Trump’s move to abruptly cancel academic funding for researchers in California over his opposition to DEI initiatives.

headlines.title: Trump plans to take Qatari jet to Asia, but it’s unclear whether it’s been ‘maxed out’
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is expected to take the Qatari-gifted Air Force One to Asia on Monday as questions linger about upgrades the White House said were needed after a security threat from Iran forced the president to fly home from Turkey on a secret military plane in July, according to two U.S. officials.

headlines.title: Transportation secretary says he doesn’t apologize for FAA’s nationwide ground stop
headlines.description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy declined to apologize for the nationwide ground stop that stranded hundreds of thousands of travelers across the country

headlines.title: Sen.-elect Scott Colom says investing in the South can help Democrats win ‘a durable majority’
headlines.description: Sen.-elect Scott Colom, D-Miss., emphasized in that Democrats need to invest more in southern states like Mississippi, where he flipped the seat blue for the first time in decades.

headlines.title: Judge temporarily halts Trump’s ‘Trash Island’ golf course redevelopment in D.C.
headlines.description: The Trump administration cannot close East Potomac Park to the public for now, a federal judge in Washington ruled Saturday, dealing a blow to the president’s effort to renovate the park’s golf course.
